channel.description: Latest articles from The College Fix (thecollegefix.com)

item.title: ‘Anti-gay prejudice’ increasing among young people, Northwestern professors say
item.description: Younger generations are less 'pro-gay,' than older generations, Northwestern professors say. Experts say there is more to the story.

item.title: Notre Dame defends decision to appoint pro-choice scholar to leadership post
item.description: Embattled professor told The Fix she is 'fully committed to maintaining an environment of academic freedom where a plurality of voices can flourish.'

item.title: U. Kentucky staff say DEI, ‘antiracism’ are still ‘important’ in undercover videos
item.description: The University of Kentucky says it is compliant with a state ban on diversity, equity, and inclusion after undercover videos of two staffers suggest DEI teachings continue.

item.description: Faculty push back, submit their own statements Professors within the University of Houston’s College of Liberal Arts and Social Science were asked to sign an agreement promising not to “indoctrinate” students by Feb. 10. item.title: U. Maine removes U.S. Border Protection from career fair after protests
item.description: The University of Maine removed U.S. Customs and Border Protection from its upcoming career fair due to student protests and calls for a boycott by the Graduate Workers Union.

item.title: ‘Culturally insensitive’: U. Buffalo student gov’t apologizes for calling falafel an ‘Israeli’ food
item.description: Calling 'falafel' is triggering to some at the University at Buffalo.

item.title: WATCH: How much do people in D.C. know about America?
item.description: The College Fix's Pride Haggerty tests people on Capitol Hill about their knowledge of American history.

item.title: NYU professor: Trump whole milk push is ‘dog whistle to far right’
item.description: Drinking whole milk part of neo-Nazi dog whistle, New York University professor says.

item.title: Catholic Saint Mary’s College approves TPUSA after four years
item.description: Turning Point USA fought back on campus - and won.

item.title: U. California academic program ‘designed for one ethnic group’: complaint
item.description: The University of California is allegedly running a taxpayer-funded program designed exclusively for Latino students, according to a recent federal complaint filed by a legal advocacy group. The Equal Protection Project brought the complaint against the “Puente Project” for allegedly violating the Civil Rights Act of 1964 as well as the Constitution through racial discrimination. […]
